content.text: Based on the search results, I found the answer. According to the 2011 census of India, after Hindi (the fastest growing language), **Kashmiri** is the second fastest growing language.

The answer is **Kashmiri**. According to the 2011 census of India, Hindi was the fastest growing language (at 25.19%), followed by Kashmiri in second place (at 22.97%), with Meitei (Manipuri) and Gujarati tied for third place (at 20.07% and 20.4% respectively), and Bengali in fourth place (at 16.63%).
